title: Mixed Event — Relaxing Tea Time — Episode8 On This Wonderful Day

meta.Event Outline: In the lead-up to White Day, Kanade begins thinking about how to express her gratitude for the Valentine's chocolate she received, as well as for all the help she's been given. As she's struggling to think of gifts, she learns that Ichika is having the same dilemma, and the two team up!

rows.Line: White Day
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The picnic blankets are all laid out, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Hoshino.
I'm also just about finished getting the tea leaves ready.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, we've got plenty of hot water, tea leaves, snacks and a great spot! All that's left is to wait for everyone else to arrive!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you both for helping us with this, Hanasato, Momoi. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You don't need to thank us.
All we really did was carry some stuff and put up a few decorations.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Plus...the real fun hasn't started yet!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: R-Right... I hope we can be good hosts...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm starting to get a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika! Ms. Yoisaki!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hi, Honami...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you both for inviting me to this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, um... Please make yourself at home.
Do you know where Saki and the others are?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, they should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Hi, Ichi! Hi, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, right on cue.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you very much for inviting me to this♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Welcome, everyone.
Hi, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hi. I tagged along with the others after bumping into them along the way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's been a while, Yoisaki.
It's me, Kiritani. Ichika invited me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm very much looking forward to today's tea party.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, please make yourself at home.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... You're Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Cool! I've been wanting to meet you for like ever! This is great! I'm super duper happy!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Th-Thank you.
It's nice to meet you as well.
se_walk_women_001_2
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, we're here♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ena, Mizuki... Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting us, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Of course. Anyway, please sit.
I'll bring you some tea right away.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay.
Oh, this picnic blanket's super cute! I'm gonna sit here♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, is that everyone?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I guess Mafuyu couldn't make it...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting me, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to your tea party.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Th-Thank you for coming...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, have we all had a chance to grab some snacks...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! We're all set!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, good.
That just leaves the tea... How are things going, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: F-Fine, I think... I practiced quite a bit for this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Okay, I'll start with Ms. Mochizuki's cup...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (First, warm the teapot...and put in two spoonfuls of leaves.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Pour in some hot water...and let it steep.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Okay, it should be ready...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki?! A-Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I'm okay. A drop of hot water landed on me is all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Still, would you like me to help with anything?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
N-No, please let me do this.
I invited you here as a guest, so you and the others should be having a nice, relaxing time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay, I understand...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Well, here I go...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You can do it, Kanade...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hand on the lid to keep it from spilling...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And pour into the cup... Carefully...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Th-Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Geez, Ena, don't be so overprotective.
But also, that smells amazing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
We're outside, but we're still getting the full treatment!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It smells delicious.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you all very much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Anyway, Ms. Mochizuki, here's your cup.
While it's still warm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much. I'll try it now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your cups will be ready soon, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki, just give me one second.
I'll start pouring for you and the others.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
This smells wonderful...
Lemon and ginger? Is that right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it's ginger tea.
You said your shoulders were sore, and I was told about how this can help improve blood flow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Ms. Yoisaki.
That's so thoughtful of you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, what's this one called?
It smells so sweet and gentle!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's this shop's own original blend that includes...um, chamomile and lavender... It's supposed to be very soothing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know you're very busy as idols, so I tried finding something that could help you relax and recover.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This smells really nice, and it has such a soothing flavor... Thank you both for going through all this trouble!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? This tea... It tastes like... Peppermint? It's got that refreshing feel to it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Ena, yours is... Spearmint tea...
It's supposed to be refreshing like you said, so it should help you study and sleep better.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on. Did you two get different types of tea for everybody here?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, we made our choices based on things you told us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you put that much thought into this...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, you got this just for me...?
I don't know what to say!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm going to savor every drop!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay, but I can always pour you some more...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew... That's everyone for now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They all seem to be having a nice, relaxing time.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, whoa...! You're the “Ena” I've heard so much about, Shinonome?! The one who's in the same group as Asahina?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I've seen your videos!
I love them so much!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Ena's really an incredible artist.
You should see some of her drawings and paintings.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've seen her art too, and I remember being blown away by it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Th-They're really not that great.
Yes, I can draw, but only because I attend an art class.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that, but you sure sound pretty happy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's a tea party, so... I should try to talk to some people.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But, who...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Hanasato and Momoi...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ichika invited you, right? Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for not coming to talk to you sooner. Here, let's have some of these snacks together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
Let's all talk over here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, okay! Let's go, you two!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me too...? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! Come on! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. They all seem to be enjoying themselves. But...)
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you again for coming.
So, how's the tea...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I feel a bit relaxed.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yours is linden tea, Mafuyu.
It's supposed to have a very soothing floral flavor.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure if I steeped it properly, but I hope it helped a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You really got a particular kind of tea just for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, yes.
Let me know if you'd like some more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry if I caused you any trouble, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm really glad that you decided to join us for this tea party...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You didn't cause me any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't say whether or not it's this tea, but... I don't feel all that bothered.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wouldn't mind doing something like this again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (At first, I had so much trouble figuring out what to get everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm glad we gave it so much thought and decided to hold this tea party.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And I'm incredibly glad that everyone's getting this chance to take a break from their busy schedules to have a nice, relaxing time.)
